verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר
verses.on: וּמַלִיל יְיָ עִם מֹשֶׁה לְמֵימָר
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying:

oe.t: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying:

verses.he: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־כָּל־עֲדַ֧ת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֥ אֲלֵהֶ֖ם קְדֹשִׁ֣ים תִּהְי֑וּ כִּ֣י קָד֔וֹשׁ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.on: מַלֵל עִם כָּל כְּנִשְׁתָּא דִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתֵימַר לְהוֹן קַדִישִׁין תְּהוֹן אֲרֵי קַדִישׁ אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן
verses.en: Speak to the entire congregation [of] Bnei Yisroel and say to them: You shall be holy, for I, Adonoy, your God, am holy.

oe.t: Speak to the entire congregation [of] Bnei Yisroel and say to them: You shall be holy, for I, Adonoy, your God, am holy.

verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ אִמּ֤וֹ וְאָבִיו֙ תִּירָ֔אוּ וְאֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖י תִּשְׁמֹ֑רוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.on: גְבַר מִן אִמֵהּ וּמִן אֲבוּהִי תְּהוֹן דָחֲלִין וְיָת יוֹמֵי שַׁבַּיָא דִילִי תִּטְרוּן אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן
verses.en: A man—you shall fear his mother and father and keep My Sabbaths, I am Adonoy, your God.

oe.t: A man—you shall fear his mother and father and keep [
the days of
] My Sabbaths, I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: אַל־תִּפְנוּ֙ אֶל־הָ֣אֱלִילִ֔ים וֵֽאלֹהֵי֙ מַסֵּכָ֔ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ לָכֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.on: לָא תִתְפְּנוּן בָּתַר טַעֲוָן וְדַחֲלָן דְמַתְּכָא לָא תַעְבְּדוּן לְכוֹן אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן
verses.en: Do not turn to the idols and do not make molten gods for yourselves, I am Adonoy, your God.

oe.t: Do not turn to the [
false
] idols and do not make molten gods for yourselves, I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: וְכִ֧י תִזְבְּח֛וּ זֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַיהוָ֑ה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֖ם תִּזְבָּחֻֽהוּ׃
verses.on: וַאֲרֵי תִכְסוּן נִכְסַת קוּדְשַׁיָא קֳדָם יְיָ לְרַעֲוָא לְכוֹן תִּכְסֻנֵהּ
verses.en: When you slaughter a peace-offering to Adonoy, you shall slaughter it to be acceptable for you.

oe.t: When you slaughter a peace[
sacred
]-offering to [
before
] Adonoy, you shall slaughter it to be acceptable for you.

verses.he: בְּי֧וֹם זִבְחֲכֶ֛ם יֵאָכֵ֖ל וּמִֽמָּחֳרָ֑ת וְהַנּוֹתָר֙ עַד־י֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵֽף׃
verses.on: בְּיוֹמָא דְיִתְנְכֵס יִתְאֲכֵל וּבְיוֹמָא דְבַתְרוֹהִי וּדְאִשְׁתָּאַר עַד יוֹמָא תְלִיתָאָה בְּנוּרָא יִתּוֹקָד
verses.en: On the day that it is slaughtered it may be eaten and on the next day. Whatever is left over by the third day shall be burned in fire.

oe.t: On the day that it is slaughtered it may be eaten and on the next day. Whatever is left over by the third day shall be burned in fire.

verses.he: וְאִ֛ם הֵאָכֹ֥ל יֵאָכֵ֖ל בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י פִּגּ֥וּל ה֖וּא לֹ֥א יֵרָצֶֽה׃
verses.on: וְאִם אִתְאֲכָלָא יִתְאֲכֵל בְּיוֹמָא תְלִיתָאָה מְרָחַק הוּא לָא יְהֵי לְרַעַוָא
verses.en: And if it should be eaten at all on the third day it is an abomination, it will not be favorably accepted.

oe.t: And if it should be eaten at all on the third day it is an abomination [
a rejection
], it will not be favorably accepted.

verses.he: וְאֹֽכְלָיו֙ עֲוֺנ֣וֹ יִשָּׂ֔א כִּֽי־אֶת־קֹ֥דֶשׁ יְהוָ֖ה חִלֵּ֑ל וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.on: וּדְיֵיכְלִנֵהּ חוֹבֵהּ יְקַבֵּל אֲרֵי יָת קוּדְשָׁא דַיְיָ אַחֵל וְיִשְׁתֵּיצֵי אֲנָשָׁא הַהוּא מֵעַמֵהּ
verses.en: Whoever eats from it shall bear his iniquity, for the sacred [things] of Adonoy he has defiled. That [persons] soul shall be cut off from its people.

oe.t: Whoever eats from it shall bear his iniquity, for the sacred [things] of Adonoy he has defiled. That [persons] soul shall be cut off from its people.

verses.he: וּֽבְקֻצְרְכֶם֙ אֶת־קְצִ֣יר אַרְצְכֶ֔ם לֹ֧א תְכַלֶּ֛ה פְּאַ֥ת שָׂדְךָ֖ לִקְצֹ֑ר וְלֶ֥קֶט קְצִֽירְךָ֖ לֹ֥א תְלַקֵּֽט׃
verses.on: וּבְמֶחְצָדְכוֹן יָת חֲצָדָא דְאַרְעֲכוֹן לָא תְשֵׁיצֵי פָּאתָא דְחַקְלָךְ לְמֶחְצָד וּלְקָטָא דַחֲצָדָךְ לָא תְלַקֵט
verses.en: When you will reap the harvest of your land, you shall not completely reap a corner of your field, and the gleanings of your harvest you shall not gather.

oe.t: When you will reap the harvest of your land, you shall not completely reap a corner of your field, and the gleanings of your harvest you shall not gather.

verses.he: וְכַרְמְךָ֙ לֹ֣א תְעוֹלֵ֔ל וּפֶ֥רֶט כַּרְמְךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְלַקֵּ֑ט לֶֽעָנִ֤י וְלַגֵּר֙ תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֔ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.on: וְכַרְמָךְ לָא תְעַלֵל וְנִתְרָא דְכַרְמָךְ לָא תְלַקֵט לְעַנְיֵי וּלְגִיוֹרֵי תִּשְׁבּוֹק יָתְהוֹן אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן
verses.en: You shall not glean your vineyard, and the fallen grapes of your vineyard, you shall not gather. For the poor and the proselyte you shall leave them, I am Adonoy, your God.

oe.t: You shall not glean your vineyard, and the fallen grapes of your vineyard, you shall not gather. For the poor and the proselyte you shall leave them, I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: לֹ֖א תִּגְנֹ֑בוּ וְלֹא־תְכַחֲשׁ֥וּ וְלֹֽא־תְשַׁקְּר֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ בַּעֲמִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: לָא תִּגְנְבוּן וְלָא תְכַדְבוּן וְלָא תְשַׁקְרוּן אֱנַשׁ בְּחַבְרֵהּ
verses.en: You shall not steal. You shall not deny [a rightful claim] and each one of you shall not lie to each other.

oe.t: You shall not steal. You shall not deny [a rightful claim] and each one of you shall not lie to each other.

verses.he: וְלֹֽא־תִשָּׁבְע֥וּ בִשְׁמִ֖י לַשָּׁ֑קֶר וְחִלַּלְתָּ֛ אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.on: וְלָא תִשָׁבְעוּן בִּשְׁמִי לְשִׁקְרָא וְתַחֵל יָת שְׁמָא דֶאֱלָהָךְ אֲנָא יְיָ
verses.en: You shall not swear falsely by My Name profaning the Name of your God, I am Adonoy.

oe.t: You shall not swear falsely by My Name profaning the Name of your God, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: לֹֽא־תַעֲשֹׁ֥ק אֶת־רֵֽעֲךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א תִגְזֹ֑ל לֹֽא־תָלִ֞ין פְּעֻלַּ֥ת שָׂכִ֛יר אִתְּךָ֖ עַד־בֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.on: לָא תַעֲשׁוֹק יָת חַבְרָךְ וְלָא תְאַנֵס לָא תְבִית אַגְרָא דַאֲגִירָא לְוָתָךְ עַד צַפְרָא
verses.en: You shall not withhold the wages of your fellow [Jew] and you shall not rob. It shall not remain overnight, the wages of a day-laborer, keeping it in your possession until morning.

oe.t: You shall not withhold the wages of your fellow [Jew] and you shall not rob [
oppress
]. It shall not remain overnight, [
You shall not withhold
] the wages of a day-laborer, keeping it in your possession until morning.

verses.he: לֹא־תְקַלֵּ֣ל חֵרֵ֔שׁ וְלִפְנֵ֣י עִוֵּ֔ר לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן מִכְשֹׁ֑ל וְיָרֵ֥אתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.on: לָא תְלוּטּ דְלָא שָׁמַע וְקֳדָם דְלָא חָזֵי לָא תְשִׂים תַּקְלָא וְתִדְחַל מֵאֱלָהָךְ אֲנָא יְיָ
verses.en: You shall not curse a deaf person and before a blind person you shall not place a stumbling-block; you shall fear your God, I am Adonoy.

oe.t: You shall not curse a deaf person [
who can not hear
] and before a blind person [
who can not see
] you shall not place a stumbling-block; you shall fear your God, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: לֹא־תַעֲשׂ֥וּ עָ֙וֶל֙ בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט לֹא־תִשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי־דָ֔ל וְלֹ֥א תֶהְדַּ֖ר פְּנֵ֣י גָד֑וֹל בְּצֶ֖דֶק תִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט עֲמִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.on: לָא תַעְבְּדוּן שְׁקַר בְּדִינָא לָא תִסַב אַפֵּי מַסְכֵּנָא וְלָא תֶהְדַר אַפֵּי רַבָּא בְּקוּשְׁטָא תְּדִינֵהּ לְחַבְרָךְ
verses.en: You shall not commit injustice in judgement, you shall not favor a poor man and you shall not show honor to a powerful man. With righteousness shall you judge your fellow [Jew].

oe.t: You shall not commit injustice [
lie
] in judgement, you shall not favor a poor man and you shall not show honor to a powerful man. With righteousness [
truth
] shall you judge your fellow [Jew].

verses.he: לֹא־תֵלֵ֤ךְ רָכִיל֙ בְּעַמֶּ֔יךָ לֹ֥א תַעֲמֹ֖ד עַל־דַּ֣ם רֵעֶ֑ךָ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.on: לָא תֵיכוּל קוּרְצִין בְּעַמָךְ לָא תְקוּם עַל דְמָא דְחַבְרָךְ אֲנָא יְיָ
verses.en: Do not be a tale-bearer among your people. You shall not stand idly by [when] the blood (life) of your fellow [is in danger]. I am Adonoy.

oe.t: Do not be a tale-bearer [
’eat and wink’
] among your people. You shall not stand idly by [when] the blood (life) of your fellow [is in danger]. I am Adonoy.

verses.he: לֹֽא־תִשְׂנָ֥א אֶת־אָחִ֖יךָ בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ הוֹכֵ֤חַ תּוֹכִ֙יחַ֙ אֶת־עֲמִיתֶ֔ךָ וְלֹא־תִשָּׂ֥א עָלָ֖יו חֵֽטְא׃
verses.on: לָא תִשְׂנֵי יָת אֲחוּךְ בְּלִבָּךְ אוֹכָחָא תוֹכַח יָת חַבְרָךְ וְלָא תְקַבֵּל עַל דִי לֵהּ חוֹבָא
verses.en: You shall not hate your brother in your heart; You shall certainly rebuke your friend; [but] you shall not bear a sin on his account.

oe.t: You shall not hate your brother in your heart; You shall certainly rebuke your friend; [but] you shall not bear a sin on his account.

verses.he: לֹֽא־תִקֹּ֤ם וְלֹֽא־תִטֹּר֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֔ךָ וְאָֽהַבְתָּ֥ לְרֵעֲךָ֖ כָּמ֑וֹךָ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.on: לָא תִקוֹם וְלָא תִטַר דְבָבוּ לִבְנֵי עַמָךְ וּתְרַחֵם לְחַבְרָךְ כְּוָתָךְ אֲנָא יְיָ
verses.en: You shall not take revenge or bear a grudge against the children of your people. You shall love your fellow [Jew] as yourself, I am Adonoy.

oe.t: You shall not take revenge or bear a grudge against the children of your people. You shall love your fellow [Jew] as yourself, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: אֶֽת־חֻקֹּתַי֮ תִּשְׁמֹרוּ֒ בְּהֶמְתְּךָ֙ לֹא־תַרְבִּ֣יעַ כִּלְאַ֔יִם שָׂדְךָ֖ לֹא־תִזְרַ֣ע כִּלְאָ֑יִם וּבֶ֤גֶד כִּלְאַ֙יִם֙ שַֽׁעַטְנֵ֔ז לֹ֥א יַעֲלֶ֖ה עָלֶֽיךָ׃ (פ)
verses.on: יָת קְיָמַי תִּטְרוּן בְּעִירָךְ לָא תַרְכֵּב עֵרוּבִין חַקְלָךְ לָא תִזְרַע עֵרוּבִין וּלְבוּשׁ עֵרוּבִין שַׁעַטְנֵזָא לָא יִסַק עֲלָךְ
verses.en: Keep My statutes; Do not cross-breed your animals with different species. Do not sow your field with a mixture of different seeds. A garment that contains shatnez [a forbidden mixture of linen and wool] you shall not wear.

oe.t: Keep My statutes; Do not cross-breed your animals with different species. Do not sow your field with a mixture of different seeds. A garment that contains shatnez [a forbidden mixture of linen and wool] you shall not wear.

verses.he: וְ֠אִישׁ כִּֽי־יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אֶת־אִשָּׁ֜ה שִׁכְבַת־זֶ֗רַע וְהִ֤וא שִׁפְחָה֙ נֶחֱרֶ֣פֶת לְאִ֔ישׁ וְהָפְדֵּה֙ לֹ֣א נִפְדָּ֔תָה א֥וֹ חֻפְשָׁ֖ה לֹ֣א נִתַּן־לָ֑הּ בִּקֹּ֧רֶת תִּהְיֶ֛ה לֹ֥א יוּמְת֖וּ כִּי־לֹ֥א חֻפָּֽשָׁה׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי יִשְׁכּוּב עִם אִתְּתָא שִׁכְבַת זַרְעָא וְהִיא אַמְתָא אֲחִידָא לִגְבַר וְאִתְפְּרָקָא לָא אִתְפְּרִיקַת בְּכַסְפָּא אוֹ חֵרוּתָא לָא אִתְיְהִיבַת לַהּ בִּשְׁטָר בִּקֻּרְתָּא תְהֵי לָא יוּמְתוּן אֲרֵי לָא אִתְחָרָרַת
verses.en: If a man lies with a woman in a conjugal manner, and she is a maid-servant designated for a [specific] man and she has certainly not been redeemed, or her freedom was not given to her; there shall be an investigation they shall not be put to death, for her freedom was not given to her.

oe.t: If a man lies with a woman in a conjugal manner, and she is a maid-servant designated for a [specific] man and she has certainly not been redeemed [
with money
], or her freedom was not given to her [
through a document
]; there shall be an investigation they shall not be put to death, for her freedom was not given to her.

verses.he: וְהֵבִ֤יא אֶת־אֲשָׁמוֹ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד אֵ֖יל אָשָֽׁם׃
verses.on: וְיַיְתִי יָת אַשְׁמֵהּ קֳדָם יְיָ לִתְרַע מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא דְכַר לַאֲשָׁמָא
verses.en: He shall bring his guilt-offering to Adonoy, to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, a guilt-offering-ram.

oe.t: He shall bring his guilt-offering to [
before
] Adonoy, to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, a guilt-offering-ram.

verses.he: וְכִפֶּר֩ עָלָ֨יו הַכֹּהֵ֜ן בְּאֵ֤יל הָֽאָשָׁם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עַל־חַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֑א וְנִסְלַ֣ח ל֔וֹ מֵחַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽא׃ (פ)
verses.on: וִיכַפֵּר עֲלוֹהִי כַּהֲנָא בְּדִכְרָא דַאֲשָׁמָא קֳדָם יְיָ עַל חוֹבְתֵהּ דִי חָב וְיִשְׁתְּבֵק לֵהּ מְחוֹבְתֵהּ דִי חַב
verses.en: The kohein shall atone for him with the guilt-offering-ram before Adonoy for the sin which he committed and he will be forgiven for the sin which he committed.

oe.t: The kohein shall atone for him with the guilt-offering-ram before Adonoy for the sin which he committed and he will be forgiven for the sin which he committed.

verses.he: וְכִי־תָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־הָאָ֗רֶץ וּנְטַעְתֶּם֙ כָּל־עֵ֣ץ מַאֲכָ֔ל וַעֲרַלְתֶּ֥ם עָרְלָת֖וֹ אֶת־פִּרְי֑וֹ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם עֲרֵלִ֖ים לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵֽל׃
verses.on: וַאֲרֵי תֵעֲלוּן לְאַרְעָא וְתִצְבוּן כָּל אִלָן דְמֵיכַל וּתְרַחֲקוּן רָחָקָא יַת אִבֵּהּ תְּלַת שְׁנִין יְהֵי לְכוֹן מְרָחָק לַאֲבָדָא לָא יִתְאֲכֵל
verses.en: When you will enter the land and you will plant any food-bearing tree, you shall regard its fruit as closed off. [For] three years it shall be closed off to you, it shall not be eaten.

oe.t: When you will enter the land and you will plant any food-bearing tree, you shall regard its fruit as closed off [
separated
]. [For] three years it shall be closed off [
separated
] to you [
to be destroyed
], it shall not be eaten.

verses.he: וּבַשָּׁנָה֙ הָרְבִיעִ֔ת יִהְיֶ֖ה כָּל־פִּרְי֑וֹ קֹ֥דֶשׁ הִלּוּלִ֖ים לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.on: וּבְשַׁתָּא רְבִיעֵתָא יְהֵי כָּל אִבֵּהּ קֹדֶשׁ תּוּשְׁבְּחָן קֳדָם יְיָ
verses.en: On the fourth year, all of its fruit shall be holy [upon which to say] praise[s to] Adonoy.

oe.t: On the fourth year, all of its fruit shall be holy [upon which to say] praise[s to] [
before
] Adonoy.

verses.he: וּבַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַחֲמִישִׁ֗ת תֹּֽאכְלוּ֙ אֶת־פִּרְי֔וֹ לְהוֹסִ֥יף לָכֶ֖ם תְּבוּאָת֑וֹ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.on: וּבְשַׁתָּא חֲמִישֵׁתָא תֵּיכְלוּן יָת אִבֵּהּ לְאוֹסָפָא לְכוֹן עֲלַלְתֵּהּ אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן
verses.en: On the fifth year, you may eat its fruit, so that it will increase its produce for you, I am Adonoy, your God.

oe.t: On the fifth year, you may eat its fruit, so that it will increase its produce for you, I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: לֹ֥א תֹאכְל֖וּ עַל־הַדָּ֑ם לֹ֥א תְנַחֲשׁ֖וּ וְלֹ֥א תְעוֹנֵֽנוּ׃
verses.on: לָא תֵיכְלוּן עַל דְמָא לָא תְנַחֲשׁוּן וְלָא תְעוֹנוּן
verses.en: You shall not eat [sacred offerings] [before] the blood [is sprinkled on the altar]. You shall not act on the basis of omens nor act on the basis of auspicious times.

oe.t: You shall not eat [sacred offerings] [before] the blood [is sprinkled on the altar]. You shall not act on the basis of omens nor act on the basis of auspicious times.

verses.he: לֹ֣א תַקִּ֔פוּ פְּאַ֖ת רֹאשְׁכֶ֑ם וְלֹ֣א תַשְׁחִ֔ית אֵ֖ת פְּאַ֥ת זְקָנֶֽךָ׃
verses.on: לָא תַקְפוּן פָּאתָא דְרֵישְׁכוֹן וְלָא תְחַבֵּל יָת פָּאתָא דְדִקְנָךְ
verses.en: Do not round the corners of [the hair on] your heads and you shall not destroy [by shaving] the edges of your beard.

oe.t: Do not round the corners of [the hair on] your heads and you shall not destroy [by shaving] the edges of your beard.

verses.he: וְשֶׂ֣רֶט לָנֶ֗פֶשׁ לֹ֤א תִתְּנוּ֙ בִּבְשַׂרְכֶ֔ם וּכְתֹ֣בֶת קַֽעֲקַ֔ע לֹ֥א תִתְּנ֖וּ בָּכֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.on: וְחִבּוּל עַל מִית לָא תִתְּנוּן בְּבִסְרְכוֹן וְרוּשְׁמִין חֲרִיתִין לָא תִתְּנוּן בְכוֹן אֲנָא יְיָ
verses.en: Gashes for the dead do not make in your skin. Do not put tattoo marks on yourselves, I am Adonoy.

oe.t: Gashes for the dead do not make in your skin. Do not put tattoo marks on yourselves, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: אַל־תְּחַלֵּ֥ל אֶֽת־בִּתְּךָ֖ לְהַזְנוֹתָ֑הּ וְלֹא־תִזְנֶ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ וּמָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ זִמָּֽה׃
verses.on: לָא תַחֵל יָת בְּרַתָּךְ לְאַטְעֲיוּתַהּ וְלָא תִטְעֵי אַרְעָא וְתִתְמְלֵי אַרְעָא עֵצַת חִטְאִין
verses.en: You shall not defile your daughter by causing her to engage in harlotry lest the land be turned astray, and the land be filled with lewdness.

oe.t: You shall not defile your daughter by causing her to engage in harlotry [
err
] lest the land be turned astray, and the land be filled with lewdness [
a sinful plan

verses.he: אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַ֣י תִּשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י תִּירָ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.on: יָת יוֹמֵי שַׁבַּיָא דִילִי תִּטְרוּן וּלְבֵית מַקְדְשִׁי תְּהוֹן דָחֲלִין אֲנָא יְיָ
verses.en: You shall keep My Shabbosos and you shall fear My Sanctuary, I am Adonoy.

oe.t: You shall keep [
the days of
] My Shabbosos and you shall fear [
the House of
] My Sanctuary, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: אַל־תִּפְנ֤וּ אֶל־הָאֹבֹת֙ וְאֶל־הַיִּדְּעֹנִ֔ים אַל־תְּבַקְשׁ֖וּ לְטָמְאָ֣ה בָהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.on: לָא תִתְפְּנוּן בָּתַר בִּדִין וּדְכוּרוּ לָא תִתְבְּעוּן לְאִסְתָּאָבָא בְהוֹן אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן
verses.en: You shall not turn to mediums nor seek out oracles; do not seek [them] out, so as to defile yourselves through them. I am Adonoy, your God.

oe.t: You shall not turn to mediums nor seek out oracles; do not seek [them] out, so as to defile yourselves through them. I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: מִפְּנֵ֤י שֵׂיבָה֙ תָּק֔וּם וְהָדַרְתָּ֖ פְּנֵ֣י זָקֵ֑ן וְיָרֵ֥אתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ (פ)
verses.on: מִן קֳדָם דְסַבַּר בְּאוֹרַיְתָא תְּקוּם וּתְהַדַר אַפֵּי סָבָא וְתִדְחַל מֵאֳלָהָךְ אֲנָא יְיָ
verses.en: In the presence of the elderly you shall rise and you shall respect an elder; you shall have fear of your God, I am Adonoy.

oe.t: In the presence of the elderly [
one who understands the Torah
] you shall rise and you shall respect an elder; you shall have fear of your God, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: וְכִֽי־יָג֧וּר אִתְּךָ֛ גֵּ֖ר בְּאַרְצְכֶ֑ם לֹ֥א תוֹנ֖וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וַאֲרֵי יִתְגַיַר עִמָךְ גִיוֹרָא בְּאַרְעֲכוֹן לָא תוֹנוּן יָתֵהּ
verses.en: If a proselyte comes to live with you, in your land, do not cause him anguish.

oe.t: If a proselyte comes to live [
converts
] with you, in your land, do not cause him anguish.

verses.he: כְּאֶזְרָ֣ח מִכֶּם֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם הַגֵּ֣ר ׀ הַגָּ֣ר אִתְּכֶ֗ם וְאָהַבְתָּ֥ לוֹ֙ כָּמ֔וֹךָ כִּֽי־גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.on: כְּיַצִיבָא מִנְכוֹן יְהֵי לְכוֹן גִיוֹרָא דְיִתְגַיַר בֵּינֵיכוֹן וּתְרַחֵם לֵהּ כְּוָתָךְ אֲרֵי דַיָרִין הֲוֵיתוּן בְּאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן
verses.en: As one of your native born he shall be considered by you, the proselyte who lives with you, and you shall love him as yourself, for you were strangers in the land of Egypt, I am Adonoy, your God.

oe.t: As one of your native born [
settled ones
] he shall be considered by you, the proselyte who lives with [
converts among
] you, and you shall love him as yourself, for you were strangers [
foreign resident
] in the land of Egypt, I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: לֹא־תַעֲשׂ֥וּ עָ֖וֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט בַּמִּדָּ֕ה בַּמִּשְׁקָ֖ל וּבַמְּשׂוּרָֽה׃
verses.on: לָא תַעְבְּדוּן שְׁקַר בְּדִין בִּמְשַׁחְתָּא בְּמַתְקְלָא וּבִמְכִלְתָּא
verses.en: You shall not commit injustice in judgement; in [land] measure, in weight or in volume measure.

oe.t: You shall not commit injustice [
lie
] in judgement; in [land] measure, in weight or in volume measure.

verses.he: מֹ֧אזְנֵי צֶ֣דֶק אַבְנֵי־צֶ֗דֶק אֵ֥יפַת צֶ֛דֶק וְהִ֥ין צֶ֖דֶק יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.on: מֹאזְנָוָן דִקְשׁוֹט מַתְקְלָן דִקְשׁוֹט מְכִילָן דִקְשׁוֹט וְהִינִין דִקְשׁוֹט יְהוֹן לְכוֹן אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן דִי אֲפֵּקִית יָתְכוֹן מֵאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם
verses.en: Just scales and just weights a just dry measure (ephah) and a just liquid measure (hin) you shall have for yourselves, I am Adonoy, your God who has taken you out of the land of Egypt.

oe.t: Just scales and just weights a just dry measure (ephah) [
just volume measures
] and a just liquid measure (hin) [
just hinin
] you shall have for yourselves, I am Adonoy, your God who has taken you out of the land of Egypt.

verses.he: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־כָּל־חֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־מִשְׁפָּטַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃ (פ)
verses.on: וְתִטְרוּן יָת כָּל קְיָמַי וְיָת כָּל דִינַי וְתַעְבְּדוּן יָתְהוֹן אֲנָא יְיָ
verses.en: You must keep all my statutes and all of my laws, and do [observe] them. I am Adonoy.

oe.t: You must keep all my statutes and all of my laws, and do [observe] them. I am Adonoy.

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.on: וּמַלִיל יְיָ עִם מֹשֶׁה לְמֵימָר
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying:

oe.t: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying:

verses.he: וְאֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל תֹּאמַר֒ אִ֣ישׁ אִישׁ֩ מִבְּנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּמִן־הַגֵּ֣ר ׀ הַגָּ֣ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֧ן מִזַּרְע֛וֹ לַמֹּ֖לֶךְ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת עַ֥ם הָאָ֖רֶץ יִרְגְּמֻ֥הוּ בָאָֽבֶן׃
verses.on: וְלִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תֵּימַר גְבַר גְבַר מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן גִיוֹרָא דְיִתְגַיְרוּן בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל דִי יִתֵּן מִזַרְעֵהּ לְמוֹלֶךְ אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקְטֵל עַמָא בֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל יִרְגְמֻנֵהּ בְּאַבְנָא
verses.en: And to Bnei Yisrael you shall say: that each and every man of Bnei Yisroel and from the proselytes that reside in Israel, who will give any of his children to Molech, [that] he shall surely be put to death; the people of the land shall stone him to death.

oe.t: And to Bnei Yisrael you shall say: that each and every man of Bnei Yisroel and from the proselytes that reside [
convert
] in Israel, who will give any of his children to Molech, [that] he shall surely be put to death; the people of the land [
House of Israel
] shall stone him to death.

verses.he: וַאֲנִ֞י אֶתֵּ֤ן אֶת־פָּנַי֙ בָּאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י אֹת֖וֹ מִקֶּ֣רֶב עַמּ֑וֹ כִּ֤י מִזַּרְעוֹ֙ נָתַ֣ן לַמֹּ֔לֶךְ לְמַ֗עַן טַמֵּא֙ אֶת־מִקְדָּשִׁ֔י וּלְחַלֵּ֖ל אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשִֽׁי׃
verses.on: וַאֲנָא אֶתֵּן יָת רוּגְזִי בְגַבְרָא הַּהוּא וְאֱשֵׁיצֵי יָתֵהּ מִגוֹ עַמֵהּ אֲרֵי מִזַרְעֵהּ יְהַב לְמוֹלֶךְ בְּדִיל לְסָאָבָא יָת מַקְדְשִׁי וּלְאַחַלָא יָת שְׁמָא דְקוּדְשִׁי
verses.en: I shall direct My wrath on that man and I shall cut him off from among his people, for he gave of his children to Molech, in order to defile My Sanctuary and profane My Holy Name.

oe.t: I shall direct My wrath on that man and I shall cut him off from among his people, for he gave of his children to Molech, in order to defile My Sanctuary and profane My Holy Name.

verses.he: וְאִ֡ם הַעְלֵ֣ם יַעְלִימֽוּ֩ עַ֨ם הָאָ֜רֶץ אֶת־עֵֽינֵיהֶם֙ מִן־הָאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא בְּתִתּ֥וֹ מִזַּרְע֖וֹ לַמֹּ֑לֶךְ לְבִלְתִּ֖י הָמִ֥ית אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וְאִם מִכְבַּשׁ יִכְבְּשׁוּן עַמָא בֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל יָת עֵינֵיהוֹן מִן גַבְרָא הַהוּא בִּדְיָהֵב מִזַרְעֵהּ לְמוֹלֶךְ בְּדִיל דְלָא לְקַטָלָא יָתֵהּ
verses.en: If the people of the land will hide their eyes from that person, when he gives of his children to Molech, and they do not put him to death.

oe.t: If the people of the land [
House of Israel
] will hide their eyes from that person, when he gives of his children to Molech, and they do not put him to death.

verses.he: וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י אֲנִ֧י אֶת־פָּנַ֛י בָּאִ֥ישׁ הַה֖וּא וּבְמִשְׁפַּחְתּ֑וֹ וְהִכְרַתִּ֨י אֹת֜וֹ וְאֵ֣ת ׀ כָּל־הַזֹּנִ֣ים אַחֲרָ֗יו לִזְנ֛וֹת אַחֲרֵ֥י הַמֹּ֖לֶךְ מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽם׃
verses.on: וֶאֱשַׁוֵי אֲנָא יָת רוּגְזִי בְגַבְרָא הַהוּא וּבִסְעָדוֹהִי וֶאֱשֵׁיצֵי יָתֵהּ וְיָת כָּל דְטָעָן בַּתְרוֹהִי לְמִטְעֵי בָּתַר מוֹלֶךְ מִגוֹ עַמְהוֹן
verses.en: I shall set My wrath against that man and his family; I shall cut him off, along with all those who go astray after him to go astray after Molech, [they will be cut off] from among their people.

oe.t: I shall set My wrath against that man and his family [
supporters
]; I shall cut him off, along with all those who go astray after him to go astray after Molech, [they will be cut off] from among their people.

verses.he: וְהַנֶּ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּפְנֶ֤ה אֶל־הָֽאֹבֹת֙ וְאֶל־הַיִּדְּעֹנִ֔ים לִזְנ֖וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־פָּנַי֙ בַּנֶּ֣פֶשׁ הַהִ֔וא וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י אֹת֖וֹ מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וֶאֱנַשׁ דִי יִתְפְּנֵי בָּתַר בִּדִין וּדְכוּרוּ לְמִטְעֵי בַתְרֵיהוֹן וְאֶתֵּן יָת רוּגְזִי בַּאֲנָשָׁא הַהִיא וֶאֱשֵׁיצֵי יָתֵהּ מִגוֹ עַמֵהּ
verses.en: The person who turns to mediums and oracles to stray after them; I shall direct My wrath against that person and cut him off from among his people.

oe.t: The person who turns to mediums and oracles to stray after them; I shall direct My wrath against that person and cut him off from among his people.

verses.he: וְהִ֨תְקַדִּשְׁתֶּ֔ם וִהְיִיתֶ֖ם קְדֹשִׁ֑ים כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.on: וְתִתְקַדְשׁוּן וּתְהוֹן קַדִישִׁין אֲרֵי אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן
verses.en: You shall sanctify yourselves and be holy for I am Adonoy, your God.

oe.t: You shall sanctify yourselves and be holy for I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־חֻקֹּתַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.on: וְתִטְּרוּן יָת קְיָמַי וְתַעְבְּדוּן יָתְהוֹן אֲנָא יְיָ מַקְדִשְׁכוֹן
verses.en: You must keep My statutes and do [observe] them. I am Adonoy who sanctifies you.

oe.t: You must keep My statutes and do [observe] them. I am Adonoy who sanctifies you.

verses.he: כִּֽי־אִ֣ישׁ אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְקַלֵּ֧ל אֶת־אָבִ֛יו וְאֶת־אִמּ֖וֹ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת אָבִ֧יו וְאִמּ֛וֹ קִלֵּ֖ל דָּמָ֥יו בּֽוֹ׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי גְבַר גְבַר דִי יְלוּט יָת אֲבוּהִי וְיָת אִמֵהּ אִתְקְטָּלָא יִתְקְטֵל אֲבוּהִי וְאִמֵהּ לַטּ קְטָלָא חַיָב
verses.en: Any man that curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. [Since] he has cursed his father or mother, his blood is on him.

oe.t: Any man that curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. [Since] he has cursed his father or mother, his blood is on him [
he is liable to the death penalty

verses.he: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִנְאַף֙ אֶת־אֵ֣שֶׁת אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִנְאַ֖ף אֶת־אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֑הוּ מֽוֹת־יוּמַ֥ת הַנֹּאֵ֖ף וְהַנֹּאָֽפֶת׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר דִי יְגוּף יָת אִתַּת גְבַר דִי יְגוּף יָת אִתַּת חַבְרֵהּ אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקְטֵל גַיָפָא וְגַיַפְתָּא
verses.en: A man who commits adultery with another mans wife who commits adultery with the wife of his fellow man—they shall surely be put to death—the adulterer and the adulteress.

oe.t: A man who commits adultery with another mans wife who commits adultery with the wife of his fellow man—they shall surely be put to death—the adulterer and the adulteress.

verses.he: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־אֵ֣שֶׁת אָבִ֔יו עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֖יו גִּלָּ֑ה מֽוֹת־יוּמְת֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר דִי יִשְׁכּוּב עִם אִתַּת אֲבוּהִי עֶרְיְתָא דַאֲבוּהִי גַלִי אִתְקַטָלָא יִתְקַטְלוּן תַּרְוֵיהוֹן קְטָלָא חַיָבִין
verses.en: A man who will lie [conjugally] with his fathers wife has uncovered his fathers nakedness; they both shall surely be put to death, their blood is on them.

oe.t: A man who will lie [conjugally] with his fathers wife has uncovered his fathers nakedness; they both shall surely be put to death, their blood is on them [
they are liable to the death penalty

verses.he: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־כַּלָּת֔וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמְת֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם תֶּ֥בֶל עָשׂ֖וּ דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר דִי יִשְׁכּוּב יָת כַּלָתֵהּ אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקַטְלוּן תַּרְוֵיהוֹן תִּבְלָא עֲבָדוּ קְטָלָא חַיָבִין
verses.en: A man who will lie [conjugally] with his daughter-in-law; they both shall surely be put to death they have committed an act of perversion, their blood is on them.

oe.t: A man who will lie [conjugally] with his daughter-in-law; they both shall surely be put to death they have committed an act of perversion, their blood is on them [
they are liable to the death penalty

verses.he: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֤ב אֶת־זָכָר֙ מִשְׁכְּבֵ֣י אִשָּׁ֔ה תּוֹעֵבָ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם מ֥וֹת יוּמָ֖תוּ דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר דִי יִשְׁכּוּב יָת דְכוּרָא מִשְׁכְּבֵי אִתְּתָא תּוֹעֶבְתָּא עֲבָדוּ תַּרְוֵיהוֹן אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקַטְלוּן קְטָלָא חַיָבִין
verses.en: A man who will lie [conjugally] with [another] man, in the same manner as with a woman; they both have committed an abominable act, they shall surely be put to death, their blood is on them.

oe.t: A man who will lie [conjugally] with [another] man, in the same manner as with a woman; they both have committed an abominable act, they shall surely be put to death, their blood is on them [
they are liable to the death penalty

verses.he: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִקַּ֧ח אֶת־אִשָּׁ֛ה וְאֶת־אִמָּ֖הּ זִמָּ֣ה הִ֑וא בָּאֵ֞שׁ יִשְׂרְפ֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ וְאֶתְהֶ֔ן וְלֹא־תִהְיֶ֥ה זִמָּ֖ה בְּתוֹכְכֶֽם׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר דִי יִסַב יָת אִתְּתָא וְיָת אִמַהּ עֵצַת חִטְאִין הִיא בְּנוּרָא יוֹקְדוּן יָתֵהּ וְיָתְהֶן וְלָא תְהֵי עֵצַת חִטְאִין בֵּינֵיכוֹן
verses.en: A man who marries a woman and her mother; it is lewdness. They shall be burned in fire, he and [one of] them, and there will no longer be such lewdness among you.

oe.t: A man who marries a woman and her mother; it is lewdness [
a sinful plan
]. They shall be burned in fire, he and [one of] them, and there will no longer be such lewdness [
a sinful plan
] among you.

verses.he: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֧ן שְׁכָבְתּ֛וֹ בִּבְהֵמָ֖ה מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת וְאֶת־הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה תַּהֲרֹֽגוּ׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר דִי יִתֵּן שְׁכָבְתֵּהּ בִּבְעִירָא אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקְטֵל וְיָת בְּעִירָא תִּקְטְלוּן
verses.en: A man who lies [conjugally] with an animal shall surely be put to death, and you shall also kill the animal.

oe.t: A man who lies [conjugally] with an animal shall surely be put to death, and you shall also kill the animal.

verses.he: וְאִשָּׁ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּקְרַ֤ב אֶל־כָּל־בְּהֵמָה֙ לְרִבְעָ֣ה אֹתָ֔הּ וְהָרַגְתָּ֥ אֶת־הָאִשָּׁ֖ה וְאֶת־הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה מ֥וֹת יוּמָ֖תוּ דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃
verses.on: וְאִתְּתָא דִי תִקְרַב לְכָל בְּעִירָא לְמִשְׁלַט בַּהּ וְתִקְטוֹל יָת אִתְּתָא וְיָת בְּעִירָא אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקַטְלוּן קְטָלָא חַיָבִין
verses.en: A woman who presents herself to an animal causing it to copulate with her; you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be killed, their blood is on them.

oe.t: A woman who presents herself to an animal causing it to copulate with her [
control her
]; you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be killed, their blood is on them [
they are liable to the death penalty

verses.he: וְאִ֣ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִקַּ֣ח אֶת־אֲחֹת֡וֹ בַּת־אָבִ֣יו א֣וֹ בַת־אִ֠מּוֹ וְרָאָ֨ה אֶת־עֶרְוָתָ֜הּ וְהִֽיא־תִרְאֶ֤ה אֶת־עֶרְוָתוֹ֙ חֶ֣סֶד ה֔וּא וְנִ֨כְרְת֔וּ לְעֵינֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י עַמָּ֑ם עֶרְוַ֧ת אֲחֹת֛וֹ גִּלָּ֖ה עֲוֺנ֥וֹ יִשָּֽׂא׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר דִי יִסַב יָת אֲחָתֵהּ בַּת אֲבוּהִי אוֹ בַת אִמֵהּ וְיֶחֱזֵי יָת עֶרְיְתַהּ וְהִיא תֶחֱזֵי יָת עֶרְיְתֵהּ קְלָנָא הוּא וְיִשְׁתֵּיצוּן לְעֵינֵי בְּנֵי עַמְהוֹן עֶרְיַת אֲחָתֵהּ גַלִי חוֹבֵהּ יְקַבֵּל
verses.en: A man who marries his sister, either his fathers daughter or his mothers daughter, and he sees her nakedness and she sees his nakedness; it is a shameful perversion. They shall be cut off before their people he has uncovered the nakedness of his sister, he shall bear [the burden of] his iniquity.

oe.t: A man who marries his sister, either his fathers daughter or his mothers daughter, and he sees her nakedness and she sees his nakedness; it is a shameful perversion. They shall be cut off before their people he has uncovered the nakedness of his sister, he shall bear [the burden of] his iniquity.

verses.he: וְ֠אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אֶת־אִשָּׁ֜ה דָּוָ֗ה וְגִלָּ֤ה אֶת־עֶרְוָתָהּ֙ אֶת־מְקֹרָ֣הּ הֶֽעֱרָ֔ה וְהִ֕יא גִּלְּתָ֖ה אֶת־מְק֣וֹר דָּמֶ֑יהָ וְנִכְרְת֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽם׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר דִי יִשְׁכּוּב יָת אִתְּתָא סוֹאֲבָתָא וִיגַלֵי יָת עֶרְיְתַהּ יָת קְלָנַהּ גַלִי וְהִיא תְגַלֵי יָת סוֹאֲבַת דְמָהָא וְיִשְׁתֵּיצוּן תַּרְוֵיהוֹן מִגוֹ עַמְהוֹן
verses.en: A man who will lie [conjugally] with a menstruating woman and uncover her nakedness and uncover her source [womb] and she has uncovered the source of her blood; they shall both be cut off from among their people.

oe.t: A man who will lie [conjugally] with a menstruating [
an impure
] woman and uncover her nakedness and uncover her source [womb] [
shameful perversion
] and she has uncovered the source [
impurity
] of her blood; they shall both be cut off from among their people.

verses.he: וְעֶרְוַ֨ת אֲח֧וֹת אִמְּךָ֛ וַאֲח֥וֹת אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה כִּ֧י אֶת־שְׁאֵר֛וֹ הֶעֱרָ֖ה עֲוֺנָ֥ם יִשָּֽׂאוּ׃
verses.on: וְעֶרְיַת אֲחַת אִמָךְ וַאֲחַת אָבוּךְ לָא תְגַלֵי אֲרֵי יָת קָרִיבֵהּ גַלִי חוֹבְהֶן יְקַבְּלוּן
verses.en: The nakedness of your mothers sister and of your fathers sister, you shall not uncover, for the nakedness of his close kin he will have bared they shall bear [the burden of] their iniquity.

oe.t: The nakedness of your mothers sister and of your fathers sister, you shall not uncover, for the nakedness of his close kin he will have bared they shall bear [the burden of] their iniquity.

verses.he: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־דֹּ֣דָת֔וֹ עֶרְוַ֥ת דֹּד֖וֹ גִּלָּ֑ה חֶטְאָ֥ם יִשָּׂ֖אוּ עֲרִירִ֥ים יָמֻֽתוּ׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר דִי יִשְׁכּוּב יָת אִתַּת אַח אֲבוּהִי עֶרְיַת אַח אֲבוּהִי גַלִי חוֹבְהֶן יְקַבְּלּוּן בְּלָּא וְלָד יְמוּתוּן
verses.en: A man who will lie [conjugally] with his aunt has uncovered the nakedness of his uncle they will bear [the burden of] their sin and they will die without children.

oe.t: A man who will lie [conjugally] with his aunt [
father’s brother’s wife
] has uncovered the nakedness of his uncle [
father’s brother
] they will bear [the burden of] their sin and they will die without children.

verses.he: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִקַּ֛ח אֶת־אֵ֥שֶׁת אָחִ֖יו נִדָּ֣ה הִ֑וא עֶרְוַ֥ת אָחִ֛יו גִּלָּ֖ה עֲרִירִ֥ים יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר דִי יִסַב יָת אִתַּת אֲחוּהִי מְרָחָקָא הִיא עֶרְיְתָא דַאֲחוּהִי גַלִי בְּלָא וְלָד יְהוֹן
verses.en: A man who will marry his brothers wife who must be [conjugally] avoided [by him]; he has uncovered his brothers nakedness, they shall die without children.

oe.t: A man who will marry his brothers wife who must be [conjugally] avoided [by him]; he has uncovered his brothers nakedness, they shall die without children.

verses.he: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־כָּל־חֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־מִשְׁפָּטַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹא־תָקִ֤יא אֶתְכֶם֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֜י מֵבִ֥יא אֶתְכֶ֛ם שָׁ֖מָּה לָשֶׁ֥בֶת בָּֽהּ׃
verses.on: וְתִטְרוּן יָת כָּל קְיָמַי וְיָת כָּל דִינַי וְתַעְבְּדוּן יָתְהוֹן וְלָא תְרוֹקֵן יָתְכוֹן אַרְעָא דִי אֲנָא מָעֵיל יָתְכוֹן תַּמָן לְמִתַּב בַּהּ
verses.en: You shall keep all of My statutes and all of My laws and do (observe) them [so that] you will not be expelled by the land to which I am bringing you there to reside therein.

oe.t: You shall keep all of My statutes and all of My laws and do (observe) them [so that] you will not be expelled by the land to which I am bringing you there to reside therein.

verses.he: וְלֹ֤א תֵֽלְכוּ֙ בְּחֻקֹּ֣ת הַגּ֔וֹי אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֥י מְשַׁלֵּ֖חַ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֤י אֶת־כָּל־אֵ֙לֶּה֙ עָשׂ֔וּ וָאָקֻ֖ץ בָּֽם׃
verses.on: וְלָא תְהָכוּן בְּנִימוֹסֵי עַמְמַיָא דִי אֲנָא מַגְלֵי מִן קֳדָמֵיכוֹן אֲרֵי יָת כָּל אִלֵין עֲבָדוּ וְרָחִיק מֵימְרִי יָתְהוֹן
verses.en: You shall not follow the customs of the nation which I am expelling before you. For they have done all these above mentioned sins and I became disgusted with them.

oe.t: You shall not follow the customs of the nation which I am expelling before you. For they have done all these above mentioned sins and I became disgusted with [
my Word distanced
] them.

verses.he: וָאֹמַ֣ר לָכֶ֗ם אַתֶּם֮ תִּֽירְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־אַדְמָתָם֒ וַאֲנִ֞י אֶתְּנֶ֤נָּה לָכֶם֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֹתָ֔הּ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָ֑שׁ אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הִבְדַּ֥לְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִן־הָֽעַמִּֽים׃
verses.on: וַאֲמָרִית לְכוֹן אַתּוּן תִּירְתוּן יָת אַרְעֲהוֹן וַאֲנָא אֶתְּנִנַהּ לְכוֹן לְמֵירַת יָתַהּ אַרְעָא עַבְדָא חַלָב וּדְבָשׁ אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן דִי אַפְרֵשִׁית יָתְכוֹן מִן עַמְמַיָא
verses.en: And I have said to you [that] you shall inherit their land, and I shall give it to you that you may inherit it, a land flowing with milk and honey, I am Adonoy, your God who separated you from the [other] peoples.

verses.he: וְהִבְדַּלְתֶּ֞ם בֵּֽין־הַבְּהֵמָ֤ה הַטְּהֹרָה֙ לַטְּמֵאָ֔ה וּבֵין־הָע֥וֹף הַטָּמֵ֖א לַטָּהֹ֑ר וְלֹֽא־תְשַׁקְּצ֨וּ אֶת־נַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶ֜ם בַּבְּהֵמָ֣ה וּבָע֗וֹף וּבְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּרְמֹ֣שׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־הִבְדַּ֥לְתִּי לָכֶ֖ם לְטַמֵּֽא׃
verses.on: וְתַפְרְשׁוּן בֵּין בְּעִירָא דַכְיָא לִמְסָאָבָא וּבֵין עוֹפָא מְסָאָבָא לִדְכֵי וְלָא תְשַׁקְצוּן יָת נַפְשָׁתֵיכוֹן בִּבְעִירָא וּבְעוֹפָא וּבְכֹל דִי תַרְחֵשׁ אַרְעָא דִי אַפְרֵשִׁית לְכוֹן לְסָאָבָא
verses.en: You shall distinguish between a [ritually] clean animal and a unclean one, between the unclean fowl and the clean one. Do not make yourselves disgusting through the animals, fowl or through any creature that creeps on the ground which I have distinguished for you as being unclean.

oe.t: You shall distinguish between a [ritually] clean animal and a unclean one, between the unclean fowl and the clean one. Do not make yourselves disgusting through the animals, fowl or through any creature that creeps on the ground which I have distinguished for you as being unclean.

verses.he: וִהְיִ֤יתֶם לִי֙ קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י קָד֖וֹשׁ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וָאַבְדִּ֥ל אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִן־הָֽעַמִּ֖ים לִהְי֥וֹת לִֽי׃
verses.on: וּתְהוֹן קֳדָמַי קַדִישִׁין אֲרֵי קַדִישׁ אֲנָא יְיָ וְאַפְרֵשִׁית יָתְכוֹן מִן עַמְמַיָא לְמֶהֱוֵי פָלְחִין קֳדָמַי
verses.en: You shall be holy to Me, for I, Adonoy, am holy and I have distinguished you from the [other] peoples to be Mine [and to serve Me].

verses.he: וְאִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ־אִשָּׁ֗ה כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֨ה בָהֶ֥ם א֛וֹב א֥וֹ יִדְּעֹנִ֖י מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑תוּ בָּאֶ֛בֶן יִרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃ (פ)
verses.on: וּגְבַר אוֹ אִתְּתָא אֲרֵי יְהֵי בְהוֹן בִּדִין אוֹ דְכוּרוּ אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקַטְלוּן בְּאַבְנָא יִרְגְמוּן יָתְהוֹן קְטָלָא חַיָבִין
verses.en: If among the men or women there will be a medium or an oracle they shall surely be put to death. You shall stone them to death, their blood is on them.
